manifest.title: Make a style (from model texts)
manifest.description: Takes "this is how we write" from texts or pages you want to follow, and turns it into rules a machine checks every time (chaff.yaml) and a guide you read while writing (STYLE.md). It also checks that the model texts get no findings under your own style, and that the style catches a text broken on purpose.

sources.label: The texts to follow (files, folders or URLs, one per line)
sources.why: The style is measured from these. Nothing that is not in them becomes part of the style

kind.label: What kind of documents are they?
kind.why: It decides which checks to use and how strict to start

options.ビジネス文書（提案書・報告書・メール・議事録・プレスリリース）: Business documents (proposals, reports, emails, minutes, press releases)
options.その他（契約書・規程・論文・本など）: Other (contracts, regulations, papers, books and so on)

language.label: Language
language.why: Japanese and English use different checks

options.手本から自動で判定する: Detect it from the model texts

audience.label: Who reads these texts, and what are they for?
audience.why: It becomes the guide's introduction, and the basis for decisions while writing
audience.placeholder: e.g. A tech blog for engineers outside the company, written to get them to try the product

strictness.label: How strict should it be?
strictness.why: Whether to match the model texts, or also lean toward fixing their weak points

options.手本に合わせる（手本が通る範囲で）: Match the model texts (as far as they pass)
options.手本より少し厳しく（手本の直すべき所は手引きに書く）: A little stricter than the model texts (what they should fix goes in the guide)

sources.title: Collect the model texts
sources.description: Collects the model texts into .blueprint/sources/ as Markdown, and keeps a note of where each came from.

rules.title: Write the style and the guide
rules.description: Measures the model texts with chaff, and writes the rules a machine checks (chaff.yaml) and the guide you read while writing (STYLE.md). Each decision keeps its reason.

counter.title: Test that the style works
counter.description: Writes a text that goes against the guide on purpose, and checks that chaff points it out. When the style is changed, checks again that the model texts still pass.

report.title: Report
report.description: What became a machine rule, what was left to the guide, and what was not made part of the style.

shanai.title: Make a style from company procedure texts
shanai.description: Takes "this is how we write" from the eight sample guides (tehon-1.md to tehon-8.md), and turns it into rules a machine checks (chaff.yaml) and a guide you read while writing (STYLE.md).
